Import assignments

Choose a JSON backup, CSV, or Moodle calendar (.ics). Imports merge by ID; nothing is deleted.

CSV columns: title,module,given,due,zone,type,estimate,notes. Use YYYY-MM-DD for given. Calendar imports leave the given date unknown until you add it. Use ISO dates with an offset, e.g. 2026-11-20T15:00:00+00:00. Moodle calendars may also contain classes and other events; review imported items.
